name: Stoatchat
description: Stoatchat is an open-source chat platform and community server, forked from Revolt. It offers real-time messaging, voice channels, file sharing and a full-featured web client.

notes.text: Registration is open and the first account becomes the administrator. Register it right away, then set invite_only = true in /Revolt.toml to restrict sign-ups.
Back up the files encryption key in /Revolt.toml. Without it, all uploaded files are unreadable.
Voice and video calls need a separate LiveKit setup, see https://github.com/stoatchat/self-hosted.
